question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

BLEND
solution:
The correct answer is "**merge**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **BLEND**: mix (a substance) with another substance so that they combine together.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Merge: **combine or cause to combine to form a single entity.
